weeks.content:
Every child is special
Say one thing I can do

When someone gives me something
Say thank you with a smile

Ask kindly for what I need
Practise please in role play

Say what really happened
The truth is always best

Touch friends gently
Hands are for helping

Listen to mummy, daddy and teacher
Do it the first time

Keep my body and class clean
Clean habits are good habits

Be kind to everyone
Invite a new friend to play

Say I forgive you
Play again together

Story of the good boy or girl
Sing our moral songs
